fixed_convolution.interpretation: Fixed random feature probes; these results do not test a learned end-to-end TCN.

polynomial_memory.decision: Ordered-memory mechanism did not pass replication; no official search.

learned_convolution.decision: Learned causal topology failed prospective replication; no official search.

disjoint_readout.decision: Disjoint linear decoding did not rescue the learned temporal representation; no official search.

raw_target.decision: Original-target supervision failed prospective complementary representation gate; no official search.

sequence_reservation.independence: All reserved groups are outside earlier designated research and protected training-role groups. Frozen incumbent may have seen these sequences in pretraining; independence is from new correction fit/selection, not pretrained model parameters.
sequence_reservation.replication_use: Four disjoint blocks reserved before architecture results. Each block consumed once; no adaptive tuning on a consumed block.

best_observed_development_point.interpretation: Exploratory maximum across separate training-derived populations; not an official-search score or credible replacement.
